after.worked_solution:
The net shown corresponds to a rectangular prism. The surface area of our prism consists of $2$ squares (base and top) and $4$ rectangles (side faces). 

Therefore, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Surface area} & =2\times (\text{Area of the base})+4\times (\text{Area of the side}) \\  & =2\times 4+4\times 6 \\  & =8+24 \\  & =32\,{\text{ft}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Surface area of the sides} & =4\times (\text{Area of the rectangle}) \\  & =4\times 28 \\  & =112\,{\text{ft}}^{2}.\end{aligned}

Now, the total area of the side surfaces consists of 4 rectangular faces.

Surface area of the sides=4×(Area of the rectangle)=4×28=112ft2.

The net shown corresponds to a triangular pyramid. The surface area of our pyramid consists of $1$ base triangle and $3$ side triangles. 

Therefore, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Surface area} & =1\times (\text{Area of base})+3\times (\text{Area of side}) \\  & =1\times 64+3\times 78 \\  & =64+234 \\  & =298\,{\text{mm}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
